question: For pregnant women, a special Health Care Abhiyan ' Anchal' has been launched in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For pregnant women, a special Health Care Abhiyan ' Anchal' has been launched in **Rajasthan**.
 
• In Rajasthan, a Special Health Care Abhiyan ‘**Anchal**’ has been launched in the** Karauli district for pregnant women.**
 
• More than **13 thousand women** have benefited from this Abhiyan.
 
• During the campaign, **13,144 pregnant women** were tested for their hemoglobin levels, out of which** 11,202 were found to be anemic.**
 
• These women were advised to take the right medicine and necessary nutritious diet. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan: (Sep 2023)**
